purpose: Pre-commitment for the retrospective backtest (EVIDENCE_ACCELERATION_PLAN.md). Written BEFORE any backtest result was computed. Changing any value below after seeing results is the p-hacking plan section 12 forbids; a change needs a new file with a new date and the reason.

surfaced.rule: Every stock symbol the live system's Drive journal recorded (theses, decisions, positions, wash-sale blocks) from 31 Aug to 22 Sep 2026; ETFs and funds removed (no earnings catalysts).
surfaced.caveat: Chosen by the live system in 2026, so hindsight-exposed for earlier dates; reported as its own stratum.

sampled.rule: backtest.sample_universe(LISTING_STATUS as of 2022-01-03, n=200, seed=20260922): NYSE/NASDAQ operating-company stocks active on that date, including names delisted since.
sampled.listing_snapshot: Alpha Vantage LISTING_STATUS date=2022-01-03 state=active (11,076 rows; 5,469 eligible)

universe.symbols_without_earnings: Reported by name as contributing zero windows, never dropped silently.

windows.catalyst: each quarterly EARNINGS reportedDate; decision = reportedDate - 21 days, taken pre-market at the next session

two_sources.method: backtest.two_sources_proxy over backtest.av_publisher_items (distinct publishers inside Alpha Vantage NEWS_SENTIMENT; Robinhood news is not queryable by past date)
two_sources.validation: Plan section 6b: agreement with real LLM judgment on 30-50 windows; results are not treated as evidence unless agreement >= 85% with a low false-clear rate.

gate.prices: backtest.evaluate_price_conditions sized as the $1,000 agentic account (quantcore defaults: 2% risk, 25% gap haircut, 18% cap, whole shares)

preregistration.hypothesis: Ideas clearing the backtest gate produce positive 21-day excess return over SPY after costs.
preregistration.scored_by: evidence.settle at the horizon close (stops ignored, as the live claim is registered) and evidence.assess
